mapper.select: SELECT ae.id, ae.activity_id AS activityId, ae.member_id AS memberId, ae.member_name AS memberName, ae.member_phone AS memberPhone, ae.enrollment_status AS enrollmentStatus, ae.enrollment_time AS enrollmentTime, ae.remark, ae.create_time AS createTime, ae.update_time AS updateTime, ae.enrollment_type AS enrollmentType, ae.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName FROM activity_enrollment ae LEFT JOIN course c ON ae.course_id = c.id WHERE ae.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY ae.enrollment_time DESC

SELECT ae.id, ae.activity_id AS activityId, ae.member_id AS memberId, ae.member_name AS memberName, ae.member_phone AS memberPhone, ae.enrollment_status AS enrollmentStatus, ae.enrollment_time AS enrollmentTime, ae.remark, ae.create_time AS createTime, ae.update_time AS updateTime, ae.enrollment_type AS enrollmentType, ae.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName FROM activity_enrollment ae LEFT JOIN course c ON ae.course_id = c.id WHERE ae.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY ae.enrollment_time DESC
